outcome: One Story can start a durable delivery run that checkpoints, interrupts, resumes, and completes Planner then Generator then Evaluator without duplicating finished work
acceptance: a Story that fails Definition of Ready cannot start a delivery run
start writes a durable checkpoint outside the in-memory agent runtime
interrupt after a persisted step then resume on a new runtime does not re-run that step
duplicate or stale events are rejected and do not change run state
cancel records a visible reason and a recoverable handoff
retry limits block unbounded repair loops
driving one ready Story through the run records Planner, Generator, and Evaluator outputs and Evaluator evidence on the WorkItem
developer progress shows the Story delivery run and can start, pause, resume, or cancel it
outOfScope: child task generation from a workflow template
assumptions: lint and hygiene remain blocked probe scripts
Story delivery uses the deterministic three-agent executors
